summary: Achieve Life Sciences filed a Form 8-K disclosing a new at-the-market (ATM) offering agreement with Jefferies LLC, allowing sales of up to $150 million of common stock at the company's discretion. The ATM shares will be sold under an existing Form S-3 shelf registration and a prospectus supplement dated August 14, 2026. Jefferies receives up to 3.0% compensation and customary indemnification. Proceeds are intended for commercialization of cytisinicline, a Phase 3 e-cigarette cessation trial, and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital-raising facility, not a special-situation event; the company has no obligation to sell and may suspend at any time.
